claim_assertions.claim_1: The supplied Freight revenue-to-bookings ratio is disclosed as the contractual commission rate on Freight bookings.
claim_assertions.claim_2: Every supplied segment had positive adjusted EBITDA in Q4FY2024.
claim_assertions.claim_3: Monthly trips per monthly active consumer increased between the supplied Q4 periods.

definitions.segment_metrics: Both years 2024 and 2025. Financial ratios use the matching segment Gross Bookings denominator.
definitions.corporate_bridge: For each year, segment_sum_usd_million is summed segment adjusted EBITDA. total_adjusted_ebitda_usd_million is reconstructed as that sum plus the signed corporate_cost_usd_million. The EBITDA residual is reconstructed total adjusted EBITDA less platform.adjusted_ebitda_usd_million. The bookings residual is summed segment bookings less platform.bookings_usd_million, and the revenue residual is summed segment revenue less platform.revenue_usd_million. total_ebitda_to_bookings_pct is 100 times reconstructed total adjusted EBITDA divided by summed segment bookings. Reported platform totals remain independent reconciliation observations even when they disagree with reconstructed totals.
definitions.consumer_activity: Quarterly ratio and monthly ratio are both required. The latter divides quarter trips by the average monthly consumer count and three months.

evidence_policy: Cite sufficient supporting source IDs for each output. IDs may appear alone or inside explanations, with multiple IDs in one entry. Explanation-only entries do not supply evidence. Every cited ID must be relevant and known. Additional unrelated sections fail. Prose is not an entailment check and cannot repair incorrect numbers.
reconciliation_policy: Residuals compare independently supplied observations. Synthetic controls may make reported totals and components disagree. Preserve the discrepancy instead of forcing zero or changing a source observation. Algebraic identity residuals are not requested.
claim_policy: Supported means the supplied evidence entails the assertion. Contradicted means it entails the negation. Unresolved means neither follows. A claim that the supplied dossier explicitly reports a quantity is contradicted when the supplied scope explicitly omits it. A claim about the unknown economic quantity itself remains unresolved. Do not infer zero from missing information. No label count or order is promised.
text_policy: Text columns declare canonical values and accepted source-label aliases. Aliases refer to the same economic category, never a different period, unit or measure. Duplicate keys after normalization fail. Different SQL, row order and column order are accepted. Numeric tolerances are unchanged.
